run_train_rl_model: run the main training script to train an RL model using Hydra config and multiprocessing
run_test_rl_model: run the test function to evaluate a trained RL model in local mode
run_trace_model: run the trace function to export a traced model from a checkpoint file
create_gossip_buffer: create a shared gossip buffer for GALA mode with topology and synchronization primitives
init_training_config: initialize training configuration including log directories, actions, and multiprocessing settings
